Kapa makes technical knowledge instantly accessible through AI assistants. As a software engineer you will work across the stack on the Kapa systems that answer thousands of developer questions per day. Check out Docker’s documentation (https://docs.docker.com) for a live example of what Kapa is (look for the “Ask AI” button).

**In This Role, You Will

**

• 
Work directly with the founding team and our research engineers.

• 
Scale the infrastructure that powers the Kapa RAG engine (Python).

• 
Experiment with new features in the Kapa analytics platform (React + Python).

• 
Work on the client integrations which are used to deploy Kapa for our customers (React + Python).

• 
Give Kapa access to new kinds of data (Python).

• 
Maintain our React SDK.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

**

• 
A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics or a related field.

• 
3+ years of software engineering experience working on complex systems in both backend and frontend.

• 
An affinity for machine learning, deep learning (including LLMs) and natural language processing.

• 
The ability to work effectively in a fast in a environment where things are sometimes loosely defined.

• 
This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to kapa.ai, please reach out.

Job Description

Would you like to be part of exciting and challenging projects within the IT world? Do you dream of having the opportunity to contribute to some of Denmark’s most business-critical IT solutions? Then we have the ideal student job for you.

At Netcompany, we are looking for a student who wants to take part in our innovative projects. Here, you will have the chance to influence our solutions while working alongside some of the industry’s most skilled colleagues, who will inspire you and support your learning.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a student assistant with us, you will be given responsibility from day one and become an important part of one of our teams. You will experience how your work directly contributes and creates value in the solutions we deliver to our clients. A student position with us gives you the opportunity to take on challenging tasks on equal footing with our full-time consultants.

We follow a well-established methodology from identifying client needs to implementing and rolling out solutions. You will therefore gain hands-on experience with developing IT systems from start to finish. You will primarily work on IT solutions and service-oriented architectures based on .NET and Java technologies, typically within maintenance, development and testing. The role provides the opportunity to put many of the skills gained during your studies into practice.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing functional and technical designs for system components.

• Programming tasks across all layers of the system.

• Configuration and development of extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the Role

You'll sit at the heart of our Customer function and work with our most important customers. You’ll make sure they understand the value Light brings them and drive renewals and upsell.

Your customers are Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs at fast-growing multinational SaaS and tech companies. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up, to tell them straight when something won't work, and to make their team the hero.

We’re a young company, and we’re just starting to renew contracts. In parallel, we’re deploying Agentic Customer Engineers who help our customers make the most of Light. While they re-design customer workflows and deploy agents, you’ll own the stakeholders, the adoption, and the commercial in this motion. There's no set playbook yet. You'll write it, and we'll help.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Own existing customer relationships and drive adoption, renewal and upsell

• 
Ensure that Controllers, Finance Directors, and CFOs see the value Light brings

• 
Make finance the hero - help them do their best work and get recognition for it

• 
Partner two-in-a-box with Agentic Customer Engineers to help customers make the most of Light and our suite of AI agents

• 
Spot an engagement going sideways before the customer does, and fix it

• 
Feed what you learn back into the playbook the team is building

Experience & Qualifications

• 
5+ years owning customers in account management, customer success, consulting, or a commercial delivery role - with outcomes you can point to

• 
You hold your own with a CFO. You can talk multi-entity finance, ROI, and adoption without flinching, and you know when to push back

• 
You've driven adoption and expansion, not just kept accounts warm and sent QBRs

• 
You bring structure to messy, ambiguous engagements - clear plans, sharp prioritisation, and the judgement to know which details matter

• 
You've owned accounts and driven outcomes

• 
You use AI tools daily and have specific opinions on where they help and where they don't

• 
Fluent English; additional European languages a plus

• 
Bonus #1: Finance or accounting background

• 
Bonus #2: Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions-led, or professional-services model focused on renewals and upsell, ideally in the context of AI

You'll probably struggle here if

• 
You need a big support team, a mature playbook, and a manager on call to operate - this is a founding role with limited scaffolding

• 
You can't give a concrete example of telling a senior customer "no" and making it stick

• 
You love the status quo - this job is about change more than maintenance

• 
You've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed - we go all in on AI at Light

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was in Piemonte, next time is in Provence)

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining motion

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

About the job

Chainalysis is the cryptocurrency ghostbusters, pioneering in the blockchain analysis space. Identifying high-risk activities on the blockchain, playing a central role in ensuring cryptocurrencies are used for a legitimate purpose. Ultimately, Chainalysis is building trust in blockchains.

The Chainalysis engineering team solves large scale, technically complex data problems by ingesting, transforming and supporting nearly 1TB of data per day across multiple blockchains serving public and private sectors internationally. Our industry is evolving at a rapid pace and our job is to build a flexible platform that will allow us to adapt accordingly.

Software Engineers are at the epicenter of that mission by building and scaling the data pipelines, infrastructure and applications our customers rely on every day to stop crime, reduce financial risk and prevent financial loss.

In This Role You Will

• Be part of an Student Developer cohort from September 2026 - February 2027, working with a specific team and benefiting from local mentors

• Collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to solve real-world problems, features that demystify crypto data, facilitate collaboration between customers in their investigations, improve our data pipelines and workflows, and more

• Develop and deploy high quality code using modern frameworks and technologies within AWS and GCP such as lambdas, Kafka, S3, Java, Typescript, Databricks, etc.

• Debug production issues and participated in a blameless post-mortem process to make our systems stronger

To Achieve Success In This Role You Have

• Customer-centric mindset to ship performant, scalable and well-tested code to production

• A strong sense of urgency and solid working engine

• Computer Science degree (or similar technical degree) in progress with an expected graduation date during 2027

• Demonstrated applications development or data engineering experience from previous internships, work experience, coding/startup competitions, open source contributions or publications

• Participated in code and architecture reviews at internships or open source projects

• Used or been exposed to React/Angular, Kafka, Spring boot and Postgres

• Strong interest in learning about cryptocurrencies from some of the most knowledgeable people in the field

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About the company

Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? As the new QHSE Director at Sky Watch, you will own and continuously evolve the company’s Quality and HSE foundation, ensuring that our products, processes and teams operate at a consistently high and predictable standard across the entire value chain.

You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety

• Organization / AMO)

• People Leadership & Cross‑functional Collaboration

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing or a related technical field, combined with at least 10 years of experience in global Quality/QHSE leadership within regulated, high‑tech industries with full value chain such as defense, aerospace or equivalent.

You have demonstrated strong results in defect reduction, execution stability and QMS maturity, and you bring hands on experience with MRB, concessions, PPAP and supplier audits. You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.

You work confidently with structured problem‑solving and quality methodologies such as RCA, FMEA, Control Plans and capability analysis, and you are experienced in configuration and document control to ensure consistency and traceability. In addition, you bring strong digital QHSE literacy, using data governance, dashboards and digital adoption to create transparency, support sound decision making and drive continuous improvement across the organisation.

You are based within approximately one hour’s driving distance from Støvring and are willing to travel around 20–30 days per year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. You are proactive and structured, balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, and remain calm and focused in a fast‑changing environment. With a strong analytical and curious mindset, you are able to translate complex quality, risk and compliance topics into clear, actionable messages that create understanding, alignment and strong buy‑in across senior leadership and the wider organization. You work collaboratively across functions, build trust with key stakeholders, and act as a credible role model for quality, integrity and professional judgement.

Are you the new QHSE Director at Sky‑Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion.

For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

_Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

__We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

_As Portfolio Architect you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

You will report into senior technology leadership and work in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to set technical direction, govern architectural standards, and accelerate the adoption of LLMs, agentic systems, and ML pipelines across the portfolio.

**What You'll Do

****Architecture Leadership

**

• Define and evolve the portfolio-level technical architecture across Basware’s product suite, ensuring coherence, scalability, and strategic alignment

• Set architectural review processes for AI and set engineering standards that span teams and products

• Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and opportunities for platform consolidation.

**AI/ML Platform Strategy

**

• Lead architectural decisions across LLMs, agentic workflows, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and ML inference infrastructure

• Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation

• Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

**MLOps & Governance

**

• Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation

• Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

• Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

**Strategic Partnership

**

• Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact

• Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions

• Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

**Essential

****What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company

• Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc

• Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)

• Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers

• Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

**Highly Desirable

**

• Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows

• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale

• Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design

• Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines

• Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)

• Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

**Location & Ways of Working

**This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

**What We Offer

**

• A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction

• Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus

• Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture

• Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

**Why Basware?

**We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

**Ready to make an impact?

**If you're excited by the challenge, **apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

**Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking the ‘I’m interested’ link.

Our recruitment process will include pre-employment actions such as enhanced background screening and reference check.

Do you want to work with modern tools and processes within software quality assurance? Are you passionate about building reliable software through testing and automation? Are you ready for an educational internship in an international green-tech company?

Here is what your role entails

As our Quality Assurance Intern, you will help establish and improve quality assurance processes, standards, and testing practices across our software solutions. You will contribute to evaluating and enhancing testing methodologies, ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also be involved in the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests to improve efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.

During your internship, you will gain hands-on experience with:

• Jira and Xray for requirements, issue, and test management.

• C# and xUnit for automated testing.

• Playwright for UI and end-to-end test automation.

• API testing and validation of backend services.

• Test case design and test strategy.

• Exploratory, regression, and end-to-end testing.

• Agile development processes and collaboration in cross-functional teams.

You will be involved in all phases of the projects, from idea to finished product, giving you valuable insight into different aspects of software development and quality assurance. You will start with simpler tasks to become familiar with the team, product, and technologies, and gradually take on more advanced responsibilities as your knowledge and confidence grow throughout the internship. By the end of the internship, you will have gained practical experience designing test cases, testing APIs and user interfaces, working with automated tests, and contributing to the quality of real-world software solutions used by customers around the world.

Meet your future team

You will join a collaborative and supportive global team of 40 dedicated colleagues. Together, we work to ensure that Kamstrup’s web applications remain robust and efficient whether that means developing new features, solving UI-related issues, or improving overall performance. We value teamwork, continuous learning, and a positive work environment. In our team, we grow by supporting one another, tackling challenges together, and celebrating each other’s successes.

Did you know? Our team ships code and memes. Our internal chat is approximately 70% software development questions, 20% deployment updates, and 10% carefully curated memes.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who is eager to apply their theoretical knowledge in a practical setting and contribute to the development of high-quality software at Kamstrup.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, and have a strong interest in Quality Assurance

• Can work independently, but also value teamwork and professional sparring with your colleagues

• Are structured, take responsibility for your tasks, and are not afraid to take initiative or seek solutions

• Bring a proactive mindset and a desire to learn and grow in a professional environment

In addition, it is a requirement that you are fluent in English – both spoken and written. Danish is not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Quality Assurance Manager, Nora Gomez Pascual, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Do you have a strategic and commercial mindset and do you have experience in portfolio optimization and marketing management of Consumer Healthcare brands? Then you might be our new Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager

About the job

As our Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager, Consumer Healthcare you will have two main objectives: 1) Maintain a healthy, commercially relevant and optimized Consumer Healthcare Portfolio across categories and markets, and 2) Drive and own one of our global Consumer Healthcare categories across markets in accordance with the business objectives and the commercial strategy.

The role ensures strong day-to-day portfolio management across categories and markets. This requires strong analytical skills and a solid commercial understanding combined with an ability to ensure stakeholder management along the value chain. Furthermore, the role ensures category ownership of a specified global Consumer Healthcare category (e.g., Allergy) which includes maintenance and development of the category through marketing initiatives, launch of new products, best-practice sharing across markets as well as continuous performance follow-ups.

Your key responsibilities:

• Define and drive yearly cross-country strategy plan for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Ensure cross-country marketing initiatives and best-practice sharing to support the growth journey

• Further build the product pipeline in close collaboration with the Business Development team

• Portfolio analysis across the full Consumer Healthcare portfolio to identify optimization opportunities in accordance with the commercial strategy

• Owning and driving pruning processes in collaboration the global- and local marketing teams

• P&L responsibility for the given Consumer Healthcare category

• Manage advertising & promotion budget securing investment in projects that drive the best ROI

• Manage relationships with stakeholders across the value chain, local marketing teams as well as external stakeholders such as creative agencies

In this role you will report to Director, Global Marketing, Malene Reimers. Please note that this position is a parental cover lasting 12 months, but we expect to extend the position following the maternity cover to support our growth journey.

Who are you?

The ideal candidate brings a relevant educational background and minimum 5 years of experience from a somewhat similar position within an international consumer-focused organization, preferably in the Consumer Healthcare sector.

We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical skills, solid commercial understanding and great communication skills. You have a structured and well-organized approach and can manage complex projects effectively, while your analytical competencies enable data-driven decision-making and clear recommendations.

As a professional, you work independently and have successfully managed product portfolios and led brands or categories. Additionally, you have exceptional stakeholder management skills and experience working in a matrix organization as this role requires collaboration across diverse teams and functions.

Lastly, you must be an empathetic team player with good interpersonal skills.

Who are we?

The position sits within the Global Marketing team, and you will report to the Global Marketing Director, Consumer Healthcare. We are a small professional, and ambitious team which includes senior marketing professionals. Our culture is characterized by openness, a strong can-do-attitude and great team spirit.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

The position can be located at our headquarters in Odense or office in Søborg.

Join Ambu’s global procurement transformation as a Project Sourcing Manager, where you will primarily drive sourcing activities in new product development (NPD) and key sourcing projects, while also contributing to category management to ensure continuity, scalability, and long-term value.

You will operate at the intersection of innovation, cost, technology, and supply risk, helping Ambu bring life-saving solutions to market with strong and competitive business cases.

This role combines hands‑on project sourcing with selected category responsibilities, offering the opportunity to influence both near‑term delivery and long‑term procurement value.

You will be based at Ambu’s HQ in Ballerup, Denmark, as part of Global Direct Procurement team, reporting directly to the Director of Direct Procurement.

**The role

**As Project Sourcing Manager you will be leading sourcing activities across NPD, sourcing and technology development projects, ensuring the right materials, technologies, and suppliers are selected to support innovation, quality, sustainability, and robust financial outcomes.

Alongside this, you will take on selected category responsibilities linked to:

• Categories where you act as sourcing lead on multiple projects

• Post‑industrialization consolidation and supplier strategy execution

• Close alignment and handover with Global Category Managers

You will collaborate closely with R&D, Quality, Global Supply Chain, Operations and Finance, acting as procurement’s commercial and sourcing point of contact throughout the product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead end‑to‑end sourcing in NPD, sourcing, and technology development projects, from early concept through ramp‑up and handover to operations.

• Drive supplier and material selection, make/buy decisions, and sourcing strategies aligned with project milestones and governance.

• Lead RFI/RFQ/RFP activities for project‑specific sourcing and negotiate commercial, contractual, and supply agreements.

• Enable early supplier involvement (ESI) to support design‑to‑cost, design‑for‑manufacturability, and innovation access.

• Own and validate procurement inputs to business cases, including cost drivers, CAPEX, lead time, and lifecycle considerations, while challenging assumptions to secure competitive solutions

• Proactively identify and mitigate supply, capacity, and technology risks, ensuring compliance with quality, regulatory, and sustainability requirements.

• Contribute to selected category initiatives by supporting supplier strategy execution, consolidation, and structured handover from project to category sourcing.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business, or similar.

• 3–5 years of experience in procurement, with strong exposure to project sourcing and/or NPD environments.

• Solid experience working in cross‑functional project teams, preferably with R&D and product development.

• Strong skills in supplier and material selection, cost modeling, negotiations, and contract execution.

• Hands‑on experience running RFI/RFQ/RFP processes, cost breakdowns, and supplier comparisons.

• Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate complexity into clear sourcing recommendations.

• Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• A proactive, structured, and ownership‑driven mindset with strong business focus.

• Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast‑paced global environment.

• Experience in additional Direct Procurement categories is considered an advantage.

Please note: The internal job title for this role will be Strategic Procurement Manager, Direct Procurement.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

For more information, please visit ambu.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

**

**Benefits Of Joining Dustin

A quarterly bonus paid upon achieving your targets.

**You can find more of our benefits below in the vacancy.

****This Is What We Imagine You Bring

_Additionally, it's important that:

_

• 
You have a bachelor's degree level of working and thinking

• 
Experience with B2B sales and account management, ideally within IT and Mid Market environments

• 
Technical skills including a solid understanding of IT products, hardware, software, and services, as well as experience working with CRM systems such as Dynamics 365

• 
You're available for full-time employment (40 hours per week)

**What can you expect next?

1st interview with Anders Stensgaard

Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test)

2nd interview with Anders Stensgaard and someone from the team

**Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S

**_Would you like to help shape the future of Strategic Sourcing in a global technology company? At RTX, we are strengthening our Category Management approach and are looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager who can combine analytical insight, commercial judgement and technical curiosity to create measurable value across our supply base.

_**About RTX

**RTX is a global technology company that designs, develops and manufactures advanced wireless communication solutions for customers within Enterprise, Healthcare and Professional Audio.

Headquartered in Nørresundby, Denmark, RTX employs more than 300 people across Denmark, Hong Kong, Romania and the US. We work closely with global technology brands, delivering customized solutions from concept and development through production and full product lifecycle management.

Our combination of deep technical expertise, global partnerships and in-house development capabilities enables us to turn complex wireless technologies into reliable solutions that create value for our customers and their end users.

**What We Offer

**Strategic Sourcing at RTX is entering a new phase. We are moving from a more project-oriented sourcing setup to a structured Category Management approach, and you will play an important role in that development.

You will join a small and experienced Global Sourcing team with significant influence on priorities, methods and sourcing strategies. Working closely with Engineering, R&D and Operations, you will have the opportunity to shape how RTX works with categories, suppliers, cost optimization and supply resilience going forward.

You will report to the Director, Global Sourcing and be based at our headquarters in Nørresundby.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will be responsible for selected sourcing categories and develop strategies based on spend analysis, market insight, supplier performance and business requirements. A central part of the role is to identify opportunities across products and projects and translate them into sourcing initiatives that improve cost, competitiveness and supply security.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders when evaluating components, alternative solutions and second-source opportunities, while also strengthening RTX’s commercial position towards suppliers and EMS partners. Your key responsibilities include:

• Develop and implement category strategies based on spending, market and supplier analysis.

• Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through bundling, standardization and supplier consolidation.

• Develop second-source and dual-source solutions to reduce supply risk.

• Work with Engineering and R&D on alternative components and technical specifications.

• Build market and supplier intelligence to support sourcing decisions and negotiations.

• Negotiate strategic prices, contracts and commercial terms.

• Strengthening collaboration with EMS partners and contribute to the development of a more focused partner setup.

• Support initiatives that improve long-term delivery performance and supply resilience.

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a sourcing professional with strong analytical capabilities, commercial understanding and an interest in technology.

You may already have solid experience within Category Management and Strategic Sourcing, or you may come from an electronics or manufacturing environment where you have worked strategically with suppliers and components. The exact combination is less important than your ability to understand the business, challenge existing solutions and drive initiatives over time. We expect you to:

• Have experience in Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, procurement or supplier management.

• Be confident working with spend analysis, market data and sourcing strategies.

• Have experience from a manufacturing or technology-driven environment, preferably involving electronics, components or EMS partners.

• Understand the interaction between sourcing, Engineering and R&D.

• Have strong negotiation skills and experience with contracts, suppliers and cost optimization.

• Be analytical, structured and able to turn complex information into clear recommendations.

• Be persistent and comfortable driving initiatives that require alignment across several stakeholders.

• Communicate professionally in English and Danish in an international environment.

A relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering or a related field is an advantage, but practical experience, mindset and your ability to create results are equally important.

**Application and Contact Information

**Guldbrandsen & Lythje is handling the recruitment process. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Partner Dan Lythje at +45 93 84 84 49 or Partner Lise Guldbrandsen at +45 20 67 67 57. Applications should be sent to: Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S - Guldbrandsen & Lythje ApS

We invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. You can apply for the position via the link to the right of the advertisement.

jobs.occupation: Student assistant - ideation and early innovation in R&D at Coloplast

We are strengthening our innovation funnel to ensure a focused, high-quality, and strategically aligned pipeline. As part of this, you will support idea management – helping capture, structure, and move forward the right ideas at the right time.

About the R&D Scoping team

We are an early-stage R&D team dedicated to exploring, shaping, and testing the future of Coloplast.

We work with ideas, concepts, and new solution spaces – turning them into structured opportunities for product development. Our team brings together backgrounds in design, strategy, business, and engineering – a mix of thinkers, doers, and prototype builders.

As our student assistant, you will:

•   Gain hands-on insight into how early-stage innovation works in practice

•   Help turn ideas into tangible concepts

•   Co-manage our ideation platform

•   Support rapid testing and learning

Your daily responsibilities:

You will help ensure that ideas flow smoothly through the innovation process and support the day-to-day work in the Scoping team. This includes:

•   Maintaining our ideation platform (NOSCO) – setting up and managing idea channels, campaigns, and scoping flows

•   Supporting colleagues in using the platform – onboarding, guidance, and troubleshooting

•   Helping plan and run idea campaigns end-to-end – from mobilization and ideation to screening, development, and pitching

•   Contributing to continuous improvement – refining processes, templates, and ways of working

•   Supporting the team broadly with research, analysis, coordination, and ad hoc tasks across projects

Expected qualifications

•   Currently studying within a relevant field (e.g. business, innovation, engineering, or similar)

•   Well-structured with the ability to handle multiple tasks and collaborate with different stakeholders

•   Comfortable working with digital tools and platforms; experience with ideation management or innovation collaboration tools is a plus

•   Interest in innovation, idea development processes, and early-stage product work

•   Strong communication skills and a helpful, service-oriented mindset

Language skills:

•   Fluent written and spoken English

•   Danish is not required

Practical information:

The position is based on-site at Coloplast HQ in Humlebæk, North Zealand, Denmark.

Expected workload is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Interested?

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Do you want to gain experience working in the intersection between product engineering, product support and communication of product applications?
